body: Tested locally, I found some issues: - + icons turn into X icons when hovered in the Manage Project Tags dialog, yet they add the tag to the project when clicked: https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e62a4e47-509c-48c2-8720-26b7bca96806 - When clicking a tag in the Manage Project Tags dialog, it's not removed from the project (you need click on the X button next to it instead): Some more feedback: - There is a red highlight when hovering a X icon, which is inconsistent with other X icons in the editor (e.g. the ones next to scene tabs): https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4aa2e37c-53e4-4d75-909d-d9cab807047a I would probably remove the red modulate on hover for consistency, and also because it's a bit on the distracting side. - The height of the + icon button is inconsistent with tags: - I think we should reduce tags' size to make them closer to the + button's size, rather than enlarge the + button. - Add Tag buttons take a lot of space compared to the + icon on projects with tags, which looks a bit distracting (and makes the button look like an actual tag): Considering tagging is a relatively secondary function, I don't think it should look so prominent in the project manager.
Functionality-wise seems fine, but the code could be simpler.
Minor code details left, but functionality-wise it's fine now.
